Assess observable output errors, without treating them as proof of a particular internal cognitive mechanism.
criteria.support_condition: Documented tests or independently verifiable outputs attributable to the system in the target period show recurring errors in ordinary object operation or use, with prompts and outputs sufficient to distinguish functional mistakes from deliberately unusual requests.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad, reproducible tests of ordinary object operation and use show reliable functional depictions, and attempts to reproduce the alleged difficulty establish that it arose from misleading prompts, misidentified models, or isolated artifacts rather than a recurring limitation.
